required_assets.description:
SHOT: Wide tabletop overhead flat-lay view, slow 5% push-in from 00:05.0 to 00:09.2.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Aged off-white newsprint paper surface with subtle light blue millimeter grid lines, halftone textured paper cutouts with clean drop-shadowed edges, physical paper tactile feel.
LIGHTING: Even studio tabletop illumination, warm 3400K, soft physical paper drop shadows.
LOCATION: Archival industrial engineering desk.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:03.0: A vintage halftone cutout silhouette of a 1940s professor with round spectacles and a bow tie slides in from left; a distressed paper label stamped "CORE THEORY" snaps into top left with a layered drop shadow.
- 00:03.0-00:06.0: A bold circular paper dial divided into four colored quadrants drops heavily onto center desk; four craft-paper letter blocks slam into the quadrants in rapid stop-motion: "P", "D", "C", "A".
- 00:06.0-00:09.2: A large hand-drawn red circle scribbles around the dial; paper arrows appear between each quadrant pointing clockwise; a paper label slams down reading "IMPROVE PROCESS".
TEXT: "P", "D", "C", "A", "CORE THEORY", "IMPROVE PROCESS"
AUDIO: Paper slide whoosh at 00:01.0, four snappy mechanical clicks as P-D-C-A blocks land, pencil scribble at 00:06.5, low documentary pulse, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Overhead close-up on blueprint desk, quick whip-pan to center-right at 00:02.0.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Dark blue blueprint paper background with white grid lines, mechanical paper gears and cardboard levers.
LIGHTING: Cool directional desk lamp, 4500K, crisp paper edge shadows.
LOCATION: Blueprint drafting table with paper drafting tools.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.2: An industrial blueprint schematic unfurls; two kraft-paper cut gears try to mesh but a gear tooth breaks off with a paper flutter; a paper exclamation point pops up with a vibrating red drop shadow.
- 00:02.2-00:05.0: The scene whip-pans right; three bold kraft-paper card tabs snap down sequentially from top edge in snappy stop-motion beats: green card stamped "1. PLAN", blue card stamped "2. DO", yellow card stamped "3. CHECK".
TEXT: "PROBLEM!", "1. PLAN", "2. DO", "3. CHECK"
AUDIO: Blueprint paper flutter at 00:00.5, dull mechanical snap of broken gear, three sharp paper stamp thuds at 00:02.8, 00:03.5, 00:04.2, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Medium overhead shot looking down at four-quadrant paper wheel, slow 8% rotation-tracking camera.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Off-white grid paper base, multi-colored textured cardstock cutouts (green, blue, yellow, orange), tactile layered cardboard.
LIGHTING: Warm overhead studio lights, 3200K, defined physical drop shadows under paper layers.
LOCATION: Creative design workshop desk.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.5: The fourth orange card snaps into position stamped "4. ACT"; the four cards lock together forming a complete circular puzzle wheel on the desk.
- 00:02.5-00:05.0: A vintage brass paper pointer at the wheel center begins rotating in snappy 12 FPS stop-motion steps, pointing to PLAN, then DO, then CHECK, then ACT, each quadrant lighting up with a white paper outline.
- 00:05.0-00:07.1: A bold banner stamped "THE 4 STEPS" slams down diagonally across the lower third with a thick cardboard drop shadow.
TEXT: "4. ACT", "PLAN", "DO", "CHECK", "ACT", "THE 4 STEPS"
AUDIO: Heavy rubber-stamp thud at 00:01.0, rapid mechanical typewriter clicks for dial rotation, heavy paper thud at 00:05.5, rhythmic bassline, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Tight overhead locked-off shot on the circular paper wheel, sudden vibration shake at 00:03.0.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Aged paper texture, distressed red and black rubber stamp elements, cut paper scraps.
LIGHTING: Moody studio lighting, dramatic directional cast shadows across layered paper.
LOCATION: Analytical problem-solving workspace.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:03.0: The paper pointer finishes a full 360-degree rotation and points back to ACT, but the pointer jams against a paper obstacle; red paper flashes in stop-motion; a jagged red paper cutout "X" slams onto the center with heavy drop shadow.
- 00:03.0-00:06.0: A distressed rubber stamp reading "UNRESOLVED: TRY AGAIN" stamps heavily next to the X; small paper question marks shake around the perimeter.
- 00:06.0-00:08.7: A mechanical paper arm sweeps in, pulls the pointer back to the "PLAN" start position; paper arrows light up clockwise indicating a fresh restart.
TEXT: "X", "UNRESOLVED", "RESTART: PLAN"
AUDIO: Dial jam click at 00:02.8, loud rubber stamp thud at 00:03.5, paper spring ratchet noise at 00:06.5, low tense drone, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

scenes.description: Shot 05: 迴圈堅持與綠標解決
scenes.narration: 這樣堅持下去，最後一定可以把問題解決！

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Low-angle dynamic tabletop view looking slightly across the desk surface, snap push-in at 00:02.5.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Craft paper layers, bold green and white paper labels, clean geometric cutouts.
LIGHTING: Crisp bright studio key light, 4000K, sharp paper relief shadows.
LOCATION: Problem resolution workbench.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.2: The paper dial spins rapidly in choppy stop-motion; a bold curved black dashed line loops continuously around the perimeter; paper obstacle blocks fly off the frame like paper chips.
- 00:02.2-00:04.3: The dial snaps to a dead halt; a vibrant emerald green craft-paper circle drops from above, stamped with a crisp white checkmark and the bold word "RESOLVED!".
TEXT: "LOOP", "RESOLVED!"
AUDIO: Fast fluttering paper spin sound, snappy impact thud as emerald green badge hits desk at 00:02.5, triumphant percussive hit, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

scenes.narration: 而由於品質的改善是沒有止境的。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: High wide overhead angle pulling up and backward, revealing an expansive paper horizon.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Endless grid paper landscape, origami-like folded paper layers, architectural perspective lines.
LIGHTING: Expansive even studio wash, soft paper drop shadows extending toward horizon.
LOCATION: Abstract conceptual landscape of continuous quality.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.8: The single flat paper dial begins lifting upward into 3D space, revealing that beneath it lies a continuous folded paper staircase leading infinitely forward into the distance.
- 00:01.8-00:03.5: An infinity symbol ("∞") made of braided yellow string/paper tape uncoils and hovers above the staircase; a small stamped label reads "NO FINISH LINE".
TEXT: "∞", "NO FINISH LINE"
AUDIO: Gentle paper accordion unfolding flutter at 00:01.0, subtle wind chime paper rustle, deep sustained ambient chord, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

scenes.description: Shot 07: 提高標準與螺旋上升
scenes.narration: 所以，即使先前的問題，解決了，你也可以提高標準，找到新的問題，然後啟動新一輪的PDCA來解決。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Side 45-degree angle looking at a multi-tiered paper riser structure, camera tilts upward smoothly in 12 FPS steps from bottom to top.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Layered cardboard pedestals, vertical measuring tape cutouts, halftone machinery cutouts.
LIGHTING: Warm directional rim lighting accentuating the edges of each ascending cardboard tier.
LOCATION: Quality engineering testing laboratory desk.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:03.5: On the first paper platform, a small paper trophy sits stamped "LEVEL 1: DONE". A vertical kraft paper ruler slides upward beside it, an animated pencil marks a higher target line labeled "NEW STANDARD +20%".
- 00:03.5-00:06.5: A second, larger circular PDCA paper dial slides onto a higher elevated platform directly above the first; a bold red paper tag snaps in labeled "NEW CHALLENGE".
- 00:06.5-00:09.4: The second dial's pointer begins rotating with brisk stop-motion precision; gears underneath interlock and turn, driving the entire structure higher.
TEXT: "LEVEL 1: DONE", "NEW STANDARD", "CYCLE 2", "CHALLENGE"
AUDIO: Ruler slide swoosh, pencil scribble tick, heavy cardboard drop at 00:04.0, rhythmic clockwork gear clicks, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

scenes.narration: 就這樣，透過不斷地提高標準，不斷地改善流程，就可以把產品或服務的品質，提昇到卓越的地步！

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Epic low-angle shot looking up a towering spiral staircase made of stacked circular paper dials, majestic upward tilt.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Gold foil paper accents, ivory textured cardstock, intricate paper-cut architectural spiral.
LIGHTING: Dramatic top-down golden spotlight, warm 3000K, luminous paper edge highlights and deep tactile drop shadows.
LOCATION: Hall of excellence conceptual monument.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:03.5: Multiple concentric circular paper dials stack vertically in an elegant ascending spiral helix; as each level completes, golden paper ribbons unfurl outward.
- 00:03.5-00:06.0: The camera reaches the summit; a monumental gold-foil paper badge unfolds like an origami seal; a massive rubber stamp thuds down reading "EXCELLENCE".
- 00:06.0-00:08.6: Golden craft-paper confetti flakes drift downward in choppy 12 FPS stop-motion; the letters "P - D - C - A" lock into a golden crest at top center.
TEXT: "EXCELLENCE", "P - D - C - A", "CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT"
AUDIO: Ascending xylophone/chime paper flutter sequence, monumental deep timpani/rubber-stamp thud at 00:04.2, triumphant documentary crescendo, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.
